definitions.name: Lindormi's Guidance
definitions.summary: Highlights selected route enemies and weakens them while removing the usual player-death timer penalty.

definitions.name: Xal'atath's Bargain
definitions.summary: One of four Bargain mechanics rotates weekly between Ascendant, Voidbound, Pulsar, and Devour.
definitions.success: Resolving the weekly mechanic grants a temporary party benefit.

definitions.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Ascendant
definitions.summary: Ten orbs attempt interruptible casts and can also be stopped with displacement, crowd control, or purge.
definitions.success: Each stopped cast grants temporary movement speed and Haste.
definitions.failure: Completed casts grant enemies temporary increased damage and damage reduction.

definitions.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Voidbound
definitions.summary: A Void Emissary shields itself while empowering nearby enemies and must be defeated before its cast completes.
definitions.success: Defeating the emissary grants temporary Versatility and increased ability cooldown rate.
definitions.failure: Nearby enemies gain damage and damage-reduction benefits scaled by the emissary shield remaining.

definitions.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Pulsar
definitions.summary: Players must cross and soak each other's orbiting pulsar orbs before the 15-second window expires.
definitions.success: Intercepted orbs grant the party temporary Mastery and Leech.
definitions.failure: Unintercepted orbs grant enemies temporary increased damage and damage reduction.

definitions.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Devour
definitions.summary: Each player receives a removable shield debuff that can be cleared through healing or any eligible dispel type.
definitions.success: Removed shields grant the party temporary Critical Strike and maximum health.
definitions.failure: Uncleared shields grant enemies temporary increased damage and damage reduction.

definitions.name: Xal'atath's Guile
definitions.summary: Replaces the rotating Bargain and makes deaths subtract time until the final minute of the run.

activations.condition: Always active together with Tyrannical from +10 upward.
Always active together with Fortified from +10 upward.
Replaces Xal'atath's Bargain from +12 upward; its timer penalty stops applying during the final minute.
